violation_type.title: Nutrition - Children encouraged but not forced to eat (26 TAC §746.3311(c))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition - Children encouraged but not forced to eat
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed on camera forcing a child to eat.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver was observed on camera forcing a child to eat.
This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered that a staff was forcing infants to drink their bottles.

This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the evidence provided, a caregiver placed a hand on the infant's forehead to prevent the infant from turning his head away and inserted a bite of baby food into the infant's mouth despite the infant's refusal of the baby food.

During lunch, the fruit was observed to be withheld until the majority or all the food on the plate had been consumed by each child. A caregiver was heard during the inspection telling a child to eat their green beans and then she can have her fruit.

During the review of video surveillance, it was determined that a caregiver force fed a child their bottle for approximately 3 minutes while the child's arms were retrained and the child resisted the bottle.
